DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server to connect to.

PG_PORT.description: Port number for PostgreSQL server. Default: 5432

PG_DATABASE.description: Name of PostgreSQL database for Keycloak data storage.

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username for master realm. Default: admin

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial password for admin user on first Keycloak startup only.

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: edge (Railway), passthrough, or reencrypt

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable/Disable plaintext HTTP listener (typically false for Railway)

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public hostname/URL users access Keycloak at (must match Railway domain)

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
